title: SARS-CoV-2 Variant Tree
goal: A practitioner can visually assess the SARS-CoV-2 Variant Tree scenario using its published diagram convention.

rubric.must: A rooted branching tree visibly shows the stated sister taxa and their clade relationships.
Horizontal branch lengths visibly vary to encode the supplied evolutionary distances.
The named taxa are legible at the tree tips.
The named clade is visibly highlighted distinctly from the rest of the tree.
A visible scale or distance label identifies the evolutionary-distance interpretation.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the phylo/rectangular exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The drawing visibly presents the required rooted rectangular phylogram: Alpha and Beta are sisters, BA.1 and BA.2 are sisters within a distinctly highlighted Omicron clade, and Delta is sister to that Omicron clade. Horizontal branch lengths vary, all tip labels are legible, and the substitutions/site scale is shown.

items.evidence: The rooted tree visibly groups Alpha with Beta and groups BA.1 with BA.2; Delta branches as the sister lineage to the BA.1/BA.2 clade.
Horizontal branches have visibly different lengths, including unequal Alpha/Beta, Delta, and BA.1/BA.2 terminal branches.
Alpha, Beta, Delta, BA.1, and BA.2 are clearly legible and aligned with their respective tips.
The BA.1/BA.2 branches are red and enclosed by a pale red region with a red bracket labeled Omicron.
A visible scale bar is labeled 0.001 substitutions/site, and supporting text identifies horizontal distance as substitutions/site.
